app_fee.value: The 42nd-cycle call sets a EUR 10 non-refundable application fee, paid through PagoPA; the Health and Technology PhD page says no fee is payable.
app_fee.quote: A €10 application fee, non-refundable, is to be paid within the above-mentioned deadline.

also.quote: No application fee is to be paid.

fee_waiver.value: No fee waiver for international applicants is stated in the call or the non-EU application page.

gre_general.value: The call and the programme pages checked do not require a GRE; one department page lists it 'if available' (see Statistics).

toefl_min.value: The call sets no TOEFL minimum; it only requires documents in Italian or English.

ielts_min.value: The call sets no IELTS minimum.

english_waiver.value: The call contains no English-test exemption for Indian degrees; each department checks English at its entrance or oral exam.

notes: Rules come from the 42nd-cycle (A.Y. 2026/27) second-round call and the third-round call (closed 8 October 2026); both set the EUR 10 fee and say nothing about an English exemption, GRE or TOEFL minimum. No Fall 2027 (43rd cycle) call is published yet, so deadlines are Not stated. Programme records: physics, astronomy, chemistry, math, statistics, cs, datasci, biology, biomed, earth (umbrella), environment, ece, mech, civil (umbrella), bme. Health and Technologies (DIN) is not saved as its own record, because the bme field has one record; its admission page says no application fee is payable, which conflicts with the EUR 10 fee above. Neuroscience has no PhD of that name; the Psychology PhD is not a STEM field here and is not saved. Not saved (field already has a record or not STEM): Industrial Chemistry, Nanoscience for Medicine and the Environment, Drug Discovery and Development, Agricultural, Environmental and Food Science and Technology, FishMed, Automotive Engineering for Intelligent Mobility, Science and Technology for Aerospace and Marine Engineering, EIT4SEMM, and the clinical PhDs (cardio-nephro-thoracic, oncology, surgical, veterinary, general medical, sport). Blocked URLs: none.
